subject: Starlit AI — Pilot bundle: trial extension + credits request
messages:
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@starlit.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: trial extension + credits for Starlit AI pilot

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the performance looked promising for our search assistant PoC. We have a tight internal timeline and would like to accelerate the pilot, but procurement asked if we can get two items approved before legal signs: a) 90-day trial extension so we can run a longer session-level evaluation, and b) $10k in hosted credits to offset early infra spend during onboarding.

Our goal is to show reduction in latency and a 20% improvement in response relevance vs our baseline by end of Q1. If Redwood can provide the extension + credits and a short mutual action plan, we can commit to a paid pilot immediately after the PoC and share a technical contact (Asha, cc'd).

Can you let me know if this is possible and what approvals are required?

Thanks,
Tom
Tom Reynolds
Head of Platforms, Starlit AI
procurement@starlit.ai

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@starlit.ai>
Cc: Asha Patel <asha@starlit.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: trial extension + credits for Starlit AI pilot

Tom — great to meet you and thanks for the clear ask. Short answer: we can often approve trial extensions and credits for strategic pilots, but this ask needs an executive-level exception because it combines a non-standard credit amount and an extended trial window.

Next steps I propose:
- I'll open an exception request with my manager and finance (see attached draft MAP).
- If approved, we usually do a 60–90 day pilot extension and split credits across onboarding & evaluation milestones.
- Please confirm the success metrics (latency target, relevance metric) and a point of contact for technical onboarding (Asha ok?).

I attached a one-page proposed mutual action plan and the minimal SOW template we typically use. I’ll loop in leadership for sign-off.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0193

Attachments: Starlit_POC_datasheet.xlsx, contract_redline_v1.pdf

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: trial extension + credits for Starlit AI pilot — exec exception request

Team — forwarding a request from Starlit AI. Summary: they want a 90-day pilot extension + $10k hosted credits in exchange for a committed paid pilot after the PoC. Potential upside: strategic reference in generative search vertical and likely expansion into additional teams if metrics hit. Risk: credits > our standard free-credit threshold; requires exec approval.

Proposal for approval (what I'm asking you to sign off on):
- 90-day extension from the current trial end date
- $10,000 hosted-credit grant broken into two milestone tranches (onboarding + 30-day success check)
- Standard privacy & security addenda (no customer data retention beyond trial unless agreed)

Attachments: proposed MAP, redlined SOW, quick financial impact (see exec_approval_matrix.docx).

Please reply with APPROVE / DECLINE / ASK QUESTIONS. If APPROVE, I'll prepare the DocuSign and send a PO template to procurement.

Thanks,
Neha

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: trial extension + credits for Starlit AI pilot — exec exception request

Neha — I like the strategic angle here. Approve with caveats:
- Approve $7,500 in credits instead of $10k upfront (still split in two tranches).
- Approve 75-day extension (we can stretch to 90 days only if we see committed technical engagement within first 30 days).
- Require a short weekly check-in cadence and a technical success criterion doc signed by Asha.

Logan/Markus — if you disagree speak now. Otherwise I’ll mark APPROVED and ask finance to provision credits and legal to prepare a short amendment.

Marissa Cole
VP, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 09:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: trial extension + credits for Starlit AI pilot — exec exception request

Agree with Marissa. Additional ask from my side: include an SLA for support during the PoC (two named SE hours/week guaranteed for first 6 weeks) and require Starlit to provide anonymized evaluation logs for our quality-monitoring team to validate the metrics. If they won't provide logs, we'll keep the credit at $5k.

If Neha can negotiate Asha's agreement to those terms, I'm comfortable with the 75-day / $7.5k credit.

-Markus

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@starlit.ai>, Asha Patel <asha@starlit.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: trial extension + credits for Starlit AI pilot — approved with conditions

Tom / Asha — good news: leadership approved an exception with the following conditions: 1) 75-day trial extension, 2) $7,500 hosted credits split into two tranches (onboarding + 30-day metric check), 3) two dedicated SE hours/week for first 6 weeks, and 4) anonymized evaluation logs to be shared with Redwood's quality-monitoring team for the pilot period. Legal will send a short amendment and finance will provision credits once the amendment is signed and we receive a PO.

If that works for you I’ll kick off the DocuSign and schedule a 30-minute kickoff for next week (please propose times). Attached is the final MAP and the approval matrix for your records.

Thanks — excited to get started.
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai

Attachments: exec_approval_matrix.docx, Starlit_POC_datasheet.xlsx
